market.summary: GIFT Nifty points to a weak start (about 90-105 points lower) even though US stocks rose overnight. Brent is still near $115 and the rupee hit a new low of 95.22; foreign investors went back to selling on Monday while domestic funds kept buying. The US Fed starts its two-day meeting today (decision Wednesday), and big results (L&T, Maruti, Tata Steel, Bajaj Auto) are due today. The screener's market regime is still RISK-OFF.

points.text: GIFT Nifty was at about 22,667-22,685 early this morning, 88-106 points below Monday's Nifty close of 22,753.
US stocks rose on Monday: S&P 500 +0.70%, Nasdaq about +0.8%, Dow +0.28%. Early reports on Asia this morning disagree (mixed).
Brent eased to about $114.8 but stays near a six-month high on US-Iran tension and attacks on Saudi energy sites; the rupee fell 29 paise to a record low of 95.22 per dollar.
NSE provisional flows for 26 Oct: FIIs sold a net ₹1,462 Cr and DIIs bought ₹2,610 Cr.
The Fed's two-day policy meeting begins today; the decision is due Wednesday. Nifty support is seen near 22,380-22,400 and resistance at 22,800-22,850.

market.watch: A gap-down open: let the first hour settle before acting; Brent above $117 or the rupee past 95.5 would add pressure.

HCLTECH.summary: Late on Monday HCLTech told the exchange it has completed buying Robotiq.ai, a small Croatian automation software firm (about €9 million in cash, €1.4 million revenue in 2025). It is too small to move earnings; together with Monday's Rapidus chip-design tie-up it is a positive story but not a price driver. No other new news overnight; the trade sits at about +0.8R.

points.text: NSE filing (26 Oct, 19:04 IST): acquisition of Robotic Process Automation d.o.o. (Robotiq.ai) completed; the deal, announced 30 Sep, was €9 million cash for a firm with €1.4 million revenue in 2025.

Rapidus partnership: two HCLTech centres in Bengaluru and Hubli will do chip mask design, process design kits, design-technology co-optimisation and layout work for Rapidus' 2 nm programme; the financial value and headcount were not disclosed.
Last close ₹1,417; US tech rose overnight (Nasdaq about +0.8%).

HCLTECH.watch: A close above 1,437.78 (+1R) moves the stop to cost; the stop is 1,225.82.

GROWW.summary: No new news since last evening. No new filing or company news today. Groww closed at 184.48, its second close below the 188.75 stop, so the plan's exit stands even though capital-market stocks rose (BSE +4%). The trade is still marked open in positions.json.

points.text: Close ₹184.48 vs stop ₹188.75 and entry ₹200.80: about -1.35R.
BSE Ltd was among the Nifty's top gainers today (+4%), so the market for brokers was not the problem.

GROWW.watch: The plan says exit (two closes below 188.75); a weak open makes that worse. Tell Claude your exit price so the trade can be marked CLOSED.

SEJALLTD.summary: No new news since last evening. There was no new filing or news. The stock rose to 883.80 from 845.45 as small caps bounced, so the starter is back above its 879.95 entry and well clear of the 838.03 stop. This is market relief, not a company event.

points.text: Close ₹883.80 (+4.5%) on light volume (0.56x the 20-day average); the Nifty Smallcap index rose 1.4%.

SEJALLTD.watch: Add the remaining two-thirds only above 879.95 with confirmation; a close below 838.03 is the exit.

THELEELA.summary: No new news since last evening. ITC Hotels' results today were strong (revenue +26%, profit +51%, room rates and occupancy both up), which supports Leela's own strong quarter and the view that luxury hotel demand is good. Leela closed at 582.95, back above its 579.15 result-day low and the 573.36 stop, but still below the 604.51 entry.

points.text: ITC Hotels Q2 FY27: revenue ₹1,054 Cr (+26%), PAT ₹201 Cr (+51%), EBITDA margin 32% (+263 bps), occupancy 76% (+481 bps), room rate +14%, RevPAR +21%; the shares rose up to 8%.
Leela closed at ₹582.95 (+0.9%); the screener shows accumulation (7 accumulation vs 2 distribution days in 25 sessions).

THELEELA.watch: A weak open puts it near the 573.36 stop (last close 582.95); a close below it is the exit.

INDHOTEL.summary: No new news since last evening. Indian Hotels closed at 795.50, a new post-result closing high and above the 794.75 level from this morning's note, which confirms the drift. ITC Hotels' strong quarter adds to the sector's good results. There was no new IHCL filing.

points.text: Close ₹795.50 at the top of the day's range (99.5%) on 1.1x volume; +0.2R from the ₹785.83 entry.
ITC Hotels: RevPAR +21%, occupancy 76%, and it cited healthy demand and strong MICE business in key markets.

INDHOTEL.watch: +1R is 831.19 (then the stop goes to cost); the stop is 740.47.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: No new news since last evening. This is a new trade, so this note covers the Q2 call: growth was volume-led with no one-offs, and management expects FY27 growth above its 20% guidance. The risks are concentration (the Warner tie-up is 25-30% of revenue and is up for renewal in September next year), an unsigned YouTube Shorts deal and an open CEO search. The stock closed at 716.90, 1.5% under the 727.89 entry, with the stop well below at 662.11.

points.text: Q2 FY27: revenue about ₹120 Cr (+35% YoY), operating EBITDA ₹84.6 Cr (+25%, 70.5% margin), PAT ₹55.5 Cr (+23%); interim dividend ₹6.50 and a ₹44 Cr buyback completed.
FY27 content spend stays at ₹90-100 Cr (₹71 Cr already spent in H1), so H2 costs should be lighter; about 85% of revenue comes from catalogue more than three years old.

TIPSMUSIC.watch: Wide stop (9% risk): 662.11; +1R 793.67. News on a YouTube Shorts deal would be a catalyst.
